verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox or test environment. The evidence only supports a workaround: data sources are segregated, so you can update, delete, or add data without affecting other data sources (orama-docs-48). The open-source library mirrors the Orama Cloud APIs, so a local instance could stand in for testing before migrating (orama-docs-19, orama-docs-12). missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging or test-mode environment, test API keys, documented isolation of test data from production, and independent corroboration.
